name: Mulberry Grimwich
original_name: マルベリー・グリムウィッチ
source:
[i]"We've both been killing one another's kind, have we not?"[/i]

[b]Race:[/b] Vampire
[b]Interest:[/b] Vlad
[b]Weapon:[/b] Magic

A violent and unhinged aristos vampire. Easily agitated, with a penchant for getting on the nerves of their rivals on the battlefield and throwing them off-guard.

Enamored by the strength of Vlad, the king of vampires, this love drives them to the point of delusion.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/redbell/english/characters/?page=mulberry]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
